name: ke.fhir.eclaims
title: Kenya eClaims Implementation Guide
description: The Kenya eClaims FHIR Implementation Guide defines standardized FHIR R4 profiles, extensions, value sets, and terminologies for electronic claims submission, preauthorization, and adjudication between healthcare providers and health insurance schemes in Kenya, including the Social Health Authority (SHA).
